title: The One-Batch Work Week: 4 focus blocks I'd pick again
caption:
4 focus blocks I'd pick again

Unpopular truth about this:
1️⃣ Give days themes — Content Monday, client Tuesday. Your brain stops context-switching.
2️⃣ Run 90-minute blocks — One task type per block. Phone in another room. That's the trick.
3️⃣ One admin window — Email and DMs once a day. Never as a reflex.
4️⃣ Close with a Friday review — What moved, what didn't, next week's one bet.

Agree or disagree? Weigh in.
